title: Small exponent Schatten class Toeplitz operators on convex domains of finite type
summary: In this paper, we study the characterizations of Schatten \(p\)-class Toeplitz operators on smoothly bounded convex domains of finite type in \(\C^n\). On one hand, by using discrete Kobayashi lattice, we characterize the Schatten \(p\)-class Toeplitz operators by employing a probabilistic selection method for \(0 \frac{n}{n+1}\). On the other hand, as an application, the criterion gives a geometric characterization for Schatten \(p\)-class weighted composition operators for \(0 \frac{2n}{n+1}\).
